name: Asana
summary: This guide outlines how to set up an OAuth 2.0 connection between your application (or a platform like Composio) and Asana. Asana requires you to register an app in their developer console to obtain a Client ID and Client Secret, configure a secure redirect URI, and set the needed permission scopes. The OAuth flow allows your app to act on behalf of users securely by handling tokens rather than passwords.
decision: You should create and register your own Asana OAuth app unless your platform (such as Composio) provides or confirms the use of a managed client. The passages focus on bringing your own app for both direct and Composio use cases.

prerequisites.title: Asana Account
prerequisites.body: You must have an active Asana account to access the developer console and create an app.

steps.title: Go to the Asana Developer Console
Create a New App
steps.body: Click '+ New App' and provide the required app details: Name your app and (optionally) specify a website.

steps.title: Set the Redirect URI
steps.body: For Composio, set the Redirect URI to: https://backend.composio.dev/api/v3/toolkits/auth/callback. For direct integrations, use your app's callback endpoint.

steps.title: Configure Permission Scopes
steps.body: Select the minimum set of OAuth scopes your integration needs, such as tasks:read or tasks:write. You can toggle Full permissions or choose specific scopes.

steps.title: Save and Copy Client ID/Secret
steps.body: Once your app is created, copy the Client ID and Client Secret from the Asana developer console for later use.

steps.title: Enter Credentials in Integration Platform
steps.body: Open your integration platform (e.g., Composio), navigate to the relevant authentication config and paste the Client ID, Client Secret, and Redirect URI, selecting OAuth2 as the authentication type.

steps.title: Authorize and Connect
steps.body: Click 'Connect Account' within your integration platform. Log into Asana and approve the integration when prompted. On success, the platform will store your tokens securely.

human_actions.title: Register Asana app
human_actions.body: The user must manually create the app in Asana's Developer Console.

human_actions.title: Configure OAuth scopes and Redirect URI
human_actions.body: The user must input and save the correct redirect/callback URI and choose only the scopes required for their app.

human_actions.title: Copy credentials to integration
human_actions.body: Paste the client ID and secret into your integration platform's auth configuration.

human_actions.title: Consent to OAuth prompt
human_actions.body: During first connection, log in to Asana and grant permission to the app.
